parsed.name: Typhos多行文本编辑组件
parsed.description: 一个非物理实验软件界面组件，用于通过 PyDM 通道显示、编辑并提交多行文本内容。它可根据通道写权限切换为只读模式，适合在实验控制界面中输入或查看备注、配置文本或其他字符串数据。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical laboratory software UI component for displaying, editing, and sending multiline text through PyDM channels. It can switch to read-only mode based on channel write access, making it suitable for entering or viewing notes, configuration text, or other string data in experiment control interfaces.

actions.description: 发送当前文本到通道以更新数值
actions.description_en: Send the current text to the channel to update the value

actions.description: 根据写入权限切换编辑器的只读状态
actions.description_en: Change the editor read-only state based on write access

actions.description: 设置文本编辑器的显示内容
actions.description_en: Set the displayed content of the text editor
